Class AbstractFilterRegistrationBean<T extends Filter>

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.boot.web.servlet.RegistrationBean
org.springframework.boot.web.servlet.DynamicRegistrationBean<FilterRegistration.Dynamic>
org.springframework.boot.web.servlet.AbstractFilterRegistrationBean<T>
Type Parameters:
T - 要注册的 Filter 的类型
All Implemented Interfaces:
Aware, BeanNameAware, ServletContextInitializer, Ordered
Direct Known Subclasses:
DelegatingFilterProxyRegistrationBean, FilterRegistrationBean
public abstract class AbstractFilterRegistrationBean<T extends Filter> extends DynamicRegistrationBean<FilterRegistration.Dynamic>
抽象基类 ServletContextInitializer，用于在 Servlet 3.0+ 容器中注册 Filter。
Since:
1.5.22
Author:
Phillip Webb，Brian Clozel

    • determineDispatcherTypes

      public EnumSet<DispatcherType> determineDispatcherTypes()
      确定应注册过滤器的dispatcher types。如果未配置任何类型，将根据正在注册的过滤器类型应用默认值。对返回的EnumSet进行的修改不会影响注册。
      Returns:
      调度器类型，永远不为null。
      Since:
      3.2.0
